name: Russell Hobbs
legalEntityNote: Russell Hobbs is a consumer appliance brand owned within Spectrum Brands, not the same entity as Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc., Spectrum Brands, Inc. or a regional operator. Spectrum Brands (UK) Limited, Russell Hobbs Deutschland GmbH, Spectrum Brands Australia Pty Ltd, local distributors, retailers and warranty providers can each hold different market responsibilities.
headline: Russell Hobbs small appliances across Spectrum Brands and regional operators
description: A source-backed profile of Russell Hobbs, separating the owned consumer brand, Spectrum Brands holding and operating companies, regional legal entities, small-appliance portfolio, outsourced supply chain and market-specific buyer checks.
metaDescription: Russell Hobbs brand profile: Spectrum Brands ownership, regional operators, small appliances, outsourced supply chain and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is independent and is not affiliated with Russell Hobbs or Spectrum Brands. Brand ownership and segment disclosures do not establish the factory, origin, importer, seller, legal manufacturer or warrantor for every Russell Hobbs SKU or market.
headquarters: Manchester, United Kingdom (European operating context); parent headquartered in Middleton, Wisconsin

ownership.summary: Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. reports Russell Hobbs as an owned Kitchen & Home Appliances brand in its Home and Personal Care segment. Its fiscal 2025 Form 10-K states that the segment's brands and trade names are company-owned except specified licensed brands, with Russell Hobbs not listed among those exceptions.

productPortfolio.name: Kettles, toasters and beverage appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Russell Hobbs' current official range centers on kettles and toasters and extends to coffee makers and beverage preparation.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify voltage, plug, capacity, food-contact documentation, temperature controls and local replacement parts.

productPortfolio.name: Food preparation and cooking
productPortfolio.positioning: The official range includes blenders, food preparation, grills, slow cookers, air fryers, ovens and other countertop cooking products.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm household-use limits, wattage, cooking capacity, accessories, coating declarations and destination certification.

productPortfolio.name: Irons and garment care
productPortfolio.positioning: Irons, steam generators and handheld garment steamers remain a core product group, including the 2026 Midnight Collection shown in the official Hero.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Check water specification, anti-scale consumables, steam output, electrical standard and warranty service for the exact model.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Spectrum Brands' fiscal 2025 Form 10-K states that substantially all Home and Personal Care segment products are manufactured by third-party suppliers in the Asia-Pacific region.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Spectrum Brands Home and Personal Care segment; not a factory assignment for each Russell Hobbs model
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Obtain the exact SKU's supplier, factory, origin, inspection plan, compliance file and change-control process.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The same filing says Spectrum Brands maintains ownership of most tooling and molds used by its suppliers and continuously evaluates supplier quality, cost and capacity.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm tooling ownership and approved-supplier status for the quoted model rather than assuming all factories are company-owned.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The reviewed public sources do not publish a complete Russell Hobbs model-to-factory map.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Public official materials reviewed through 7 August 2026
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require current model, plant, origin, legal manufacturer and conformity documents as contract deliverables.

marketsChannels.evidence: Spectrum Brands reports Home and Personal Care sales through large retailers, e-commerce, wholesalers, distributors, warehouse clubs and specialty outlets.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify seller authorization, destination assortment and whether commercial resale rights are included.

marketsChannels.evidence: Russell Hobbs UK's consumer terms identify Spectrum Brands (UK) Limited as the seller and legal manufacturer for covered EU-market products, with Russell Hobbs Deutschland GmbH as EU authorised representative.
marketsChannels.scope: Products and transactions covered by the reviewed UK/EU terms
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the exact destination's terms and product label because the UK/EU roles do not automatically apply worldwide.

marketsChannels.evidence: The Australia and New Zealand official terms identify Spectrum Brands Australia Pty Ltd as the website operator for the covered regional site.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the regional invoice issuer, importer, warranty provider and spare-parts route before cross-border supply.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Russell Hobbs benefits from strong British small-appliance recognition, broad category coverage and Spectrum Brands' retail network. Its main procurement risk is the gap between one global brand and multiple regional operators and third-party factories.
